claim.quote: We report the first search result for the flux of astrophysical electron antineutrinos for energies O(10) MeV in the gadolinium-loaded Super-Kamiokande (SK) detector. ... No significant excess over the expected background in the observed events is found for the neutrino energies below 31.3 MeV. Thus, the flux upper limits are placed at the 90% confidence level.

date.note: arXiv submission May 2023; published as Astrophys. J. Lett. 951, L27 (2023).

key_value_text.quote: the flux upper limits are placed at the 90% confidence level. The limits and sensitivities are already comparable with the previous SK result with pure-water (22.5 × 2970 kton·day) owing to the enhanced neutron tagging
key_value_text.value: Electron-antineutrino flux upper limits (90% CL) below Ev=31.3 MeV from a 22.5x552 kiloton-day exposure at 0.01% Gd mass concentration, comparable to the earlier pure-water SK limit (22.5x2970 kiloton-day) thanks to improved neutron tagging.

name: SK-Gd first search for astrophysical electron antineutrinos

summary.plain: After adding gadolinium to Super-Kamiokande's water in 2020 to make it much better at tagging neutrons, the collaboration used a small first slice of the new data to hunt for antineutrinos from distant, unidentified astrophysical sources. None were found yet, but the search already matched the sensitivity of a much longer run with plain water.
summary.technical: First SK-Gd physics result: 22.5x552 kiloton-day exposure at 0.01wt% Gd, searching for astrophysical electron antineutrinos (E<31.3 MeV) via inverse beta decay with enhanced neutron tagging. No significant excess found; flux upper limits set at 90% CL, already comparable to the prior pure-water SK limit despite far less exposure.

title: Search for astrophysical electron antineutrinos in Super-Kamiokande with 0.01wt% gadolinium-loaded water
why_it_matters: The first physics result from the gadolinium-loaded SK-Gd phase, demonstrating that neutron tagging works as designed and that SK-Gd's ultimate goal - detecting the diffuse supernova neutrino background - is within reach with more exposure.
